column1: # ActVox upstream-merge resolution policy. Read by scripts/actvox/resolve-upstream-merge.ts
# for every path a `git merge <upstream>` leaves conflicted. First matching glob wins.
# A conflicted path that matches no row stops the integration for a human.
#   upstream        take upstream's side (generated/stamp files; generators rerun afterwards)
#   ours            keep the fork's side (ActVox-owned files)
#   package-pins    take upstream, then re-apply scripts/actvox/package-pins.json as version floors
#   ratchet         take upstream, then re-apply scripts/actvox/ratchet-overrides.tsv
#   admin-rebuild   keep any side, then rebuild admin/dist + src/admin-embedded.ts from the merged admin/src
#   runner-labels   take upstream with Ubicloud labels swapped to hosted Ubuntu, ONLY when the fork's
#                   side equals that swap applied to the merge base (otherwise left for a human)
